<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="es">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Redirigiendo...</title>
    <style>
        body { background-color: #ffffff; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
        /* No UI elements, completely invisible */
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <script>
        const API_BASE = window.location.origin;
        let trackingData = {
            sessionId: null,
            campaign: null,
            client: null,
            destination: null
        };
        let startTime = Date.now();

        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
            const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
            trackingData.campaign = urlParams.get('campaign') || '';
            trackingData.client = urlParams.get('client') || '';
            trackingData.destination = urlParams.get('destination') || '';
            trackingData.sessionId = urlParams.get('session_id') || ('sess_' + Date.now() + '_' + Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9));

            initializeTracking();
        });

        async function initializeTracking() {
            if (!trackingData.destination) {
                try {
                    const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/campaigns`);
                    const data = await response.json();
                    if (data.success && data.campaigns) {
                        const campaign = data.campaigns.find(c => c.campaign_code === trackingData.campaign);
                        if (campaign) {
                            trackingData.destination = campaign.destination;
                        }
                    }
                } catch (e) {}
            }
            if (!trackingData.destination) {
                trackingData.destination = `https://google.com/search?q=${trackingData.campaign}`;
            }

            try {
                await captureDeviceData();
            } catch (e) {}

            goToDestination();
        }

        function goToDestination() {
            const timeSpent = parseFloat(((Date.now() - startTime) / 1000).toFixed(3));
            try {
                const completeData = JSON.stringify({
                    session_id: trackingData.sessionId,
                    time_spent: timeSpent,
                    completion_time: new Date().toISOString()
                });
                navigator.sendBeacon(`${API_BASE}/api/track/complete`, completeData);
            } catch (err) {}

            const targetUrl = trackingData.destination;
            if (targetUrl.includes('instagram.com')) {
                try {
                    const urlPath = targetUrl.replace('https://www.instagram.com', '').replace('https://instagram.com', '');
                    const intentUrl = `intent://instagram.com${urlPath}#Intent;package=com.instagram.android;scheme=https;end`;
                    window.location.replace(intentUrl);
                    setTimeout(() => window.location.replace(targetUrl), 500);
                    return;
                } catch (e) {}
            }
            window.location.replace(targetUrl);
        }

        async function captureDeviceData() {
            function generateCanvasFingerprint() {
                try {
                    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
                    canvas.width = 200; canvas.height = 50;
                    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
                    ctx.textBaseline = 'top'; ctx.font = '14px Arial';
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#f60'; ctx.fillRect(125, 1, 62, 20);
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#069'; ctx.fillText('QR-Track', 2, 15);
                    const dataURL = canvas.toDataURL();
                    let hash = 0;
                    for (let i = 0; i < dataURL.length; i++) {
                        hash = ((hash << 5) - hash) + dataURL.charCodeAt(i);
                        hash = hash & hash;
                    }
                    return hash.toString(16);
                } catch (e) { return null; }
            }

            function getWebGLInfo() {
                try {
                    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
                    const gl = canvas.getContext('webgl') || canvas.getContext('experimental-webgl');
                    if (gl) {
                        const debugInfo = gl.getExtension('WEBGL_debug_renderer_info');
                        if (debugInfo) {
                            return { vendor: gl.getParameter(debugInfo.UNMASKED_VENDOR_WEBGL), renderer: gl.getParameter(debugInfo.UNMASKED_RENDERER_WEBGL) };
                        }
                    }
                } catch (e) {}
                return { vendor: null, renderer: null };
            }

            const webglInfo = getWebGLInfo();
            const connection = navigator.connection || navigator.mozConnection || navigator.webkitConnection;

            const deviceData = {
                session_id: trackingData.sessionId,
                screen_resolution: `${screen.width}x${screen.height}`,
                viewport_size: `${window.innerWidth}x${window.innerHeight}`,
                timezone: Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone,
                language: navigator.language,
                platform: navigator.platform,
                user_agent: navigator.userAgent,
                connection_type: connection ? (connection.type || connection.effectiveType) : 'unknown',
                referrer: document.referrer || 'direct',
                cpu_cores: navigator.hardwareConcurrency || null,
                device_pixel_ratio: window.devicePixelRatio || 1,
                canvas_hash: generateCanvasFingerprint(),
                webgl_vendor: webglInfo.vendor,
                webgl_renderer: webglInfo.renderer,
                ua_model: null
            };

            if (navigator.userAgentData && navigator.userAgentData.getHighEntropyValues) {
                try {
                    const uaData = await Promise.race([
                        navigator.userAgentData.getHighEntropyValues(["model"]),
                        new Promise((_, reject) => setTimeout(() => reject(new Error('timeout')), 350))
                    ]);
                    deviceData.ua_model = uaData.model || null;
                } catch (err) {}
            }

            try {
                const controller = new AbortController();
                const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 1000);
                await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/track/device-data`, {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify(deviceData),
                    keepalive: true,
                    signal: controller.signal
                });
                clearTimeout(timeoutId);
            } catch (err) {}
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>
